title: Shared Meal Frequency Trend
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=datenight:log activity=shared_meal
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as meals, avg(duration_min) as avg_minutes by _time
| sort - _time
description: Tracks how often you sit down for a proper shared meal together instead of rushing past each other.
value: Regular shared meals are one of the easiest signals that a relationship still has breathing room during busy seasons.
implementation: Tag date-night entries by activity type; summarize shared-meal frequency and average duration each week.
visualization: Weekly chart of shared meals with average time together.
grandmaExplanation: It watches how often you actually sit down together for a real meal, which is an easy sign of connection during busy weeks.
